app.name: kobiPDF
app.tagline: kobiPDF is a free PDF reader and editor, a gift from Hidroteknik to small businesses.
app.aboutText: An offline desktop application for opening, editing, and printing documents on your computer.

open.title: Open a PDF
open.body: Click Open on the File tab or press Ctrl+O. Each PDF you open gets its own tab. If kobiPDF is your default PDF app, just double-click a PDF file.

navigate.title: Move around the document
navigate.body: Click the thumbnails or bookmarks on the left. Type a page number in the bottom bar, and zoom with the slider or Ctrl + mouse wheel. The Hand tool (H) lets you drag the page.

text.title: Add or fix text
text.body: Add Text (T) writes anywhere on the page. Edit Text (E) lets you click existing text and change it; set the font, size and color in the property bar.

markup.title: Mark up and take notes
markup.body: The Comment tab has highlight, underline, strikeout, pen, eraser, sticky note and comment box.

signature.title: Add a signature or stamp
signature.body: In the Signature / Stamp window, draw your signature with the mouse or upload an image. Signatures you place are kept in the list for next time.

pages.title: Organize pages
pages.body: The Pages tab rotates, deletes, extracts and reorders pages, and merges or splits PDFs. Drag thumbnails to reorder.

save.title: Save or print
save.body: Ctrl+S saves, Ctrl+Shift+S saves as a new file, and Ctrl+P opens the print preview. Ctrl+Z undoes any change.

free.a: Yes. There are no license fees, subscriptions or ads, and the source code is public on GitHub.

offline.q: Do I need the internet? Are my documents sent anywhere?
offline.a: No. kobiPDF runs entirely on your computer and never uploads your documents. The internet is only used when you open a link in this About window.

default.q: How do I open PDFs in kobiPDF by double-clicking?
default.a: Right-click a PDF, choose Open with > Choose another app, pick kobiPDF and tick "Always use this app". Windows doesn't let programs make themselves the default without asking.

scanned.q: Why can't I edit the text on a scanned page?
scanned.a: Scanned pages are images, not text, so Edit Text can't change them. You can still add new text with Add Text.

encrypted.q: Can I open password-protected or encrypted PDFs?
encrypted.a: Not yet. Password-protected and encrypted documents aren't supported at the moment.

undo.q: I changed something by mistake. Can I undo it?
undo.a: Yes. Ctrl+Z undoes and Ctrl+Y redoes. If you close a document with unsaved changes, kobiPDF asks first.

bug.q: I found a bug or have an idea. Where do I report it?
bug.a: Use "Report a bug or suggest a feature" on the General tab to open a new issue on GitHub.
